Interactions The interactions associated with beta blockers are dis- cussed on p.1228. Pharmacokinetics Penbutolol is readily absorbed from the gastrointesti- nal tract and peak plasma concentrations occur about 1 to 3 hours after a dose. Penbutolol is 80 to 98% bound to plasma proteins. It has a high lipid solubility.
